title: Prove QA settlement on the delivered candidate
text: Source regression tests cover unsuccessful-run cleanup, automatic verdict evidence links, late acceptance and independent review of completed captures from an aborted execution. Focused source regression also covers zero run-bound QA with other-target member acceptance, atomic siblings, resolution and driver recovery. Live delivery proof remains pending the attached deployment QA plan; source checks do not establish deployed behavior. Source regressions now cover direct item-case settlement, immutable plan-group coverage and redelivery after a recipient session ends. Deployed recipe proof remains owed to the release QA recovery plan.
